title: Fourier regularity of the constructed density
statement: Let $k,n$ be integers with $1\le k\le n$, and let $a,b$ be positive integers satisfying $2a\le b$. Set $\varepsilon=a/b$. The density on the sign cube obtained by transporting the deterministic small-bias density through the almost $k$-wise transform has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$ on every nonempty set of at most $k$ coordinates.
